description: This Java class implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel for transforming content URLs within the OFBiz framework. It processes URL arguments, modifies image URLs with size variants, and constructs content links dynamically.

classes.name: OfbizContentTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform class for generating content URLs with optional size variants within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the provided map, handling different object types and decoding URL-encoded strings.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a custom Writer that processes the template output, constructs URLs, and applies size variants if specified.
